subject: Mythology
title: Sigurd and the Dragon Fafnir
description: A quick, practical guide to Sigurd and the Dragon Fafnir.

hook.text: Fafnir was once a dwarf prince, but his greed for cursed gold transformed him into a monstrous dragon.

buildup.text: He lay on a mountain of treasure, breathing poison that killed everything near his lair for miles around.

discovery.text: Sigurd dug a trench in the path Fafnir used for water and hid inside, waiting with his reforged sword.

twist.text: As Fafnir crawled overhead, Sigurd stabbed upward through his soft belly, killing him with a single blow.

climax.text: The dying dragon warned that the cursed gold would destroy Sigurd too. He took it anyway.

punchline.text: He killed the dragon but inherited its curse.

quiz.question: How did Sigurd manage to slay the dragon Fafnir?
options: He shot it with a magical arrow from a hilltop
He hid in a trench and stabbed upward through its belly
He challenged it to a fight in an open field
